title: coprosma triflora
intro: Coprosma triflora, commonly known as the mirror bush, is a plant species native to New Zealand. This shrubby plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, where it is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestive issues and its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Coprosma triflora include its potential to exhibit antioxidant, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
